text:
maya: bringing up fenrir-3b (q4f) in the eval harness, seeing weird drop in factuality on the contrast benchmark.
maya: suspecting tokenizer/chat-template boundary - examples show invisible joiners splitting tokens.
maya: sample prompt: 'Compare: The Nile is longer than the Amazon.'
maya: tokenized as: 
```
['Compare', ':', ' ', 'The', ' ', 'Ni', '\u2060', 'le', ' ', 'is', ' ', 'longer', ' ', 'than', ' ', 'the', ' ', 'Amazon', '.']
```
maya: that U+2060 WORD JOINER is preserved and ends up mid-token, causing our answer alignment to shift in collate.
devon: can you paste the model config you used in the harness? also which chat template (system+user) you passed?
sarah: model config snippet from configs/fenrir-3b-chat.yaml:
```
model: fenrir-3b
quant: q4f
tokenizer: fenrir_tokenizer_v1
chat_template: compact_v2
preprocess: {}
```
sarah: compact_v2 template has this user block: "{instruction}\u2060\n{input}" (yes, a stray joiner slipped in during template edit)
hiro: oh that explains it. our collate step concatenates system+user with no normalization, so the joiner can end up inside token boundaries.
hiro: eval-bot ran the harness and reported misaligned spans: 120 examples with shifted answer offsets.
eval-bot: run finished for fenrir-3b/q4f, job_id=run-2026-04-05-23, mismatches=120, matches=1880, summary_metric=fact_score_v2: 0.73
devon: I think two separate issues: (1) tokenizer keeps joiner as separate codepoint (we can normalize), (2) CI/aggregator doesn't recognize fact_score_v2 - our aggregator only picks up fact_score and fact_score_v1.
ci-bot: error ingesting metrics: Unrecognized metric name 'fact_score_v2' at aggregator/ingest:42
jules: quick fix path: (A) strip/normalize joiners at collate with unicodedata.normalize('NFKC') and remove \u2060; (B) add fact_score_v2 alias in metric mapping.
jules: small downside of NFKC is it may change some language-specific ligatures, but for our English benchmarks it's ok.
devon: prefer a config flag: model_config.preprocess.normalize = true so we can toggle per-model.
sarah: I'll open a PR with two commits: normalize toggle + metric alias. attaching draft link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/fenrir-onboard/pull/42>
maya: thanks — can we also add a unit test to the eval-runner that asserts no invisible codepoints remain after collate for the chat templates?
hiro: yes, add test in tests/test_collate_normalize.py. simple case: template with \u2060 between words -> assert token boundaries identical after normalize.
jules: I'll add aggregator mapping change and a migration note so old dashboards don't drop datapoints.
ci-bot: CI job 882 failed on metrics ingest step — waiting on PRs.
sarah: PR opened, running local eval with normalize flag set and got fact_score_v2 -> 0.78 (up from 0.73), mismatches down to 12.
maya: awesome, can we backfill results for previous runs once metric alias lands?
devon: aggregator supports alias backfill via map_legacy('fact_score_v2','fact_score') script, I'll run it after deploy.
maya: ok assigning: sarah -> PR + tests, jules -> aggregator alias + migration note, devon -> backfill script + CI watchers.
sarah: on it :rocket:
jules: marking in my calendar to coordinate with observability for dashboard annotations.
maya: thanks everyone, this was a sneaky one. :thinking_face:
